items.title: fix(agents): accept double-encoded collector results (#150209)
items.summary: fix(agents): accept double-encoded collector results (#150209) * fix(agents): parse double-encoded JSON string results in structured_output Completions-style providers (e.g. dashscope/qwen) sometimes JSON-encode an object/array result as a string instead of nesting it, since the tool's own parameter schema must permit result to be a string too. Retry validation once against the parsed value before rejecting. Fixes #150167 * fix(agents): preserve unsafe integer literals when decoding double-encoded structured_output results Reuse parseJsonPreservingUnsafeIntegers instead of JSON.parse when revalidating a double-encoded string result, so oversized integer IDs (e.g. 9007199254740993) survive the retry instead of rounding. * fix(agents): satisfy assertion-safety ratchet in structured-output-tool Annotate the added params.schema cast in the double-encoded-result retry path with a // SAFETY comment; it pushed the file's uncommented type assertion count from 2 to 3, above the grandfathered per-file baseline, which failed the checks-fast-baseline-ratchets CI job.

items.title: fix(models): reject unknown fallback and alias providers (#165744)
items.summary: fix(models): reject unknown fallback and alias providers (#165744) * fix(models): reject unknown providers in models fallbacks add `openclaw models set` refuses a model whose provider no installed plugin or models.providers entry declares, but `models fallbacks add` and `models image-fallbacks add` saved the same typo silently. The bad fallback only surfaced later, when Doctor flagged it or failover needed it. Share the existing unknown-provider check with the fallback add path so both commands exit 1 without changing config. * fix(models): reject unknown providers in models aliases add `openclaw models aliases add` saved an alias to a model whose provider no installed plugin or models.providers entry declares, while `models set` refuses the same reference. A typo like `anthropc/...` was written to agents.defaults.models with exit 0 and the alias could never resolve. Reuse the shared unknown-provider check so the command exits 1 without changing config. * fix(models): keep models aliases add accepting runtime hook-alias providers The previous commit applied the unknown-provider check to models aliases add, but aliases may target providers that a plugin declares only as runtime hook aliases, which inspectModelReference reports as unknown. model-selection runtime tests cover that contract, so drop the aliases change and keep the fallbacks-only fix. * fix(models): reject provider typos while preserving runtime aliases Share default-model inspection with alias and fallback additions, retain runtime hook aliases, and warn when provider inspection is unavailable. Keep removal permissive and scope catalog warning documentation to default-model selection. Co-authored-by: Sedrak Hovhannisyan * test(models): preserve cached provider registration expectation --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger Co-authored-by: Sedrak Hovhannisyan
